purpose: Independently derive the signed mixed epsilon^2 eta nonbath Euler parent and exact lower action boundary from the frozen action, starting with analytic GE07 dust and Lambda. The original GE06 Einstein/aether/scalar jet-Euler dictionary and NL0C Y regularity are source-bound separately. This is a compiler and preregistration step, NOT physical all-sector Euler arrays, full H4 Noether or a structural error budget.
